summary: Make https://ekodi.kr/api the constitutional public API base and route capability-specific APIs through internal Service Bindings instead of public API subdomains.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform Super Administrator explicitly instructed EKODI to continue the https://ekodi.kr/api structure under EKODI orchestration and to shorten delivery time while keeping verification-first operation.
constitutionalInterpretation: The public API boundary is a canonical path on ekodi.kr. Provider and service Workers remain replaceable internal execution resources behind capability contracts. The retired generic API subdomain is neither canonical nor a compatibility redirect target.
implementedCapabilities: Retired generic API subdomain removed from production system boundaries
Redirect target for the retired generic API subdomain removed
Capability API routing for finance, personal finance, workspace and marketing services
Generic Control API remains the fallback owner for unmatched /api routes
Admin, MCP, device and monitoring clients use the apex API boundary
authorityImpact: None. Identity, permission, financial, legal and destructive authority remain unchanged.
deploymentImpact: Shared Site selects the responsible internal Service Binding from the canonical /api capability path. No new public subdomain or external provider dependency is introduced.
rollback: Revert the capability router and client path changes while retaining the last known good Shared Site and Control API Worker versions. Do not restore the retired generic API subdomain as a redirect.
